name: Owen's leather belt
description: A wide brown leather belt, one end missing the keeper loop — it was used and dropped behind the bins. The brass buckle bears a faint impression consistent with the mark on Clara's neck.

name: Fraudulent mortgage deed
description: A property mortgage document, found in Clara's flat: Hobbs Cafe and the flat above are secured against Owen Price's debt to Marcus Bell, signed with Marcus's name in a shaky hand that does not match his other signatures. Owen had someone forge it.

name: Clara's drafted note to the committee
description: On Clara's kitchen table: a draft letter to the village committee, in her handwriting, beginning 'I write to report that the property at Hobbs Cafe has been fraudulently mortgaged...' She had not yet sent it.

name: Smell of lighter fluid
description: The fire in the alley smells of lighter fluid — not a spontaneous bin fire. A disposable lighter was found in the ash, with a small sticker from the Mallet & Crown — a pub giveaway lighter. Owen drinks at the Mallet & Crown.

name: Col Hartley's delivery log
description: Col's official timber delivery log. The Tuesday page is blank — no deliveries were scheduled to Owen's yard this morning. Yet Col initially claims he was there from 06:45.

name: Mud on Owen's boots
description: Owen's boots, when examined, have a fine layer of charred ash on the soles — consistent with the burnt crate debris in the rear alley, not with the timber yard where Owen claims to have been.

name: Land Registry extract
description: A printed Land Registry extract found in Clara's flat: it confirms the cafe property was recently registered with a charge — the mortgagee is listed as Owen Price.
